content.text: I’m Nancy Gottlieb, also a returnee from the Beta Cohort and very much looking forward to going through the current program, and upgrading the ‘game’ of enhancing even more off the administrative things we can improve thanks to AI.  I run an English School and Guest House in Angola, having gone there with an NGO almost 30 years ago.  We now have close to 3000 monthly students spread out over 3 physical school sites. The Beta cohort really provided a RoadMap and the confidence to begin experimenting and implementing, and we have been doing many things.  I am hoping to really be able to tackle more fully out SOP documentation, ways to use AI to enhance our in-person lessons, and hopefully get to see a part of what Hayden can see is coming at us all like a freight train!  Very much looking forward to starting tomorrow!  Nancy
